title: Mesh-based Super-resolution of Multiscale Detonation Flows with Graph Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2511.12041v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Super-resolution flow reconstruction using state-of-the-art data-driven techniques is valuable for a variety of applications, such as subgrid/subfilter closure modeling, accelerating spatiotemporal forecasting, data compression, and serving as an upscaling tool for sparse experimental measurements. In the present work, a first-of-its-kind graph transformer approach is developed for mesh-based super-resolution (SR-GT) of reacting flows. The novel data-driven modeling paradigm leverages a graph-based flow-field representation compatible with complex geometries and non-uniform/unstructured grids. Further, the transformer backbone captures long-range dependencies between different parts of the low-resolution flow-field, identifies important features, and then generates the super-resolved flow-field that preserves those features at a higher resolution. The performance of SR-GT is demonstrated in the context of spectral-element-discr

translated_title: 基于图变换器的多尺度爆轰流网格超分辨率重建
translated_abstract: 使用最先进的数据驱动技术进行超分辨率流场重构，对于多种应用具有重要价值，例如亚格子/亚滤波闭合建模、加速时空预测、数据压缩，以及作为稀疏实验测量的升尺度工具。在本工作中，开发了一种首创的图变换器方法，用于反应流的基于网格的超分辨率重建（SR-GT）。这种新颖的数据驱动建模范式利用了基于图的流场表示方式，可与复杂几何形状以及非均匀/非结构化网格相兼容。此外，变换器骨干网络能够捕获低分辨率流场不同部分之间的长程依赖关系，识别重要特征，进而生成在更高分辨率下保留这些特征的超分辨率流场。SR-GT的性能在谱元离散……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首创性地提出了一种基于图变换器的网格超分辨率方法（SR-GT），用于反应流的多尺度爆轰流场超分辨率重建，该方法兼容复杂几何与非结构化网格，并能捕获流场中的长程依赖特征。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SR-GT, a first-of-its-kind graph transformer approach for mesh-based super-resolution of multiscale detonation and reacting flows, which is compatible with complex geometries and unstructured grids while capturing long-range dependencies in the flow field.
